name: causoryn-dev
description: Local development marketplace for the Causoryn ZCode plugin. Add this directory (integrations/zcode) via Settings -> Plugin Management -> Discover -> the + button as a local directory, then install causoryn from the list. Development and testing only; end users should install via `npx causoryn@0.3.0 setup --client zcode --yes` or the repository root `marketplace.json`.

plugins.name: causoryn
plugins.description: Deterministic, local, LLM-free code analysis for ZCode: read-only workspace graphs, architecture mapping, symbol search and evidence provenance over a stdio MCP server.
